content.body: smaug: can I land https://github.com/whatwg/dom/pull/1470 now? Not sure where we left that. I'd like to do another PR on top that will make it possible for us to use "live range" for both Range and OpaqueRange. Mainly by switching some "live range" usage to use Range instead.
